about: Games with documented shader-compilation stutter. Only entries with a real source: an https link, or "SCSKiller measurement" for SCSKiller's own. ids are Game.Id values (steam:<appid>, xbox:<package family>, epic:<app name>, ea:<content id>, gaijin:<launcher project>, hoyoplay:<game biz>); name is the fallback, compared letters and digits only, case-insensitive. date = when the entry was last checked. Embedded in the app and served at /v1/content/known-stutter.json, the same file; the app uses the served copy when it passes StutterList.TryParse.

games.name: STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor
games.reason: Shader-compilation stutter persisted through Patch 4; SCSKiller cut its startup shader compile from 813 s to 3.2 s of compile time

games.name: Atomic Heart
games.reason: Skipping its optional shader precompile causes stutter entering new locations (the director confirmed it)

games.name: Hogwarts Legacy
games.reason: Its own "Preparing Shaders" step is incomplete: shader and traversal stutter remain

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
games.reason: Severe UE5 shader-compilation hitches; its precompile is incomplete and patch 2.0 made it worse

games.name: Avowed
games.reason: Players still report shader-compilation stutter; a larger driver shader cache helps

games.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.reason: Compiles shaders once at first launch but not again after a driver update

games.name: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands
games.reason: No shader precompile step; players still report shader-compilation stutter

games.name: Borderlands 4
games.reason: Shader-compilation stutter on first-time events; players raise the driver shader cache to 100 GB

games.name: Black Myth: Wukong
games.reason: Both shader-compilation and traversal stutter reported

games.name: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers
games.reason: UE5 shader-compilation stutter is a known ongoing issue; patches haven't eliminated it

games.name: The Callisto Protocol
games.reason: Major shader-compilation stutter returned after patch v3.02; deleting and recompiling the shader cache doesn't fix it

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.reason: Shaders compile on exit but aren't remapped on next boot, causing on-the-fly shader-compilation stutter until rebuilt (an engine-level cache bug, documented on Proton)

games.name: ELDEN RING
games.reason: Digital Foundry put its launch pauses down to shader compiles, but Valve found most big hitches on Steam Deck weren't. In one session after compiling, SCSKiller measured 37 in-play frames of 50 ms or more: 2 on a ray tracing pipeline compile, 35 with no compile under them

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
games.reason: SCSKiller measured 73 pipeline compiles that blocked the game for 20 ms or more in 3.3 minutes of play with a cold cache, none after compiling; DX12 shader-compilation stutter in this game is well documented

games.name: Immortals of Aveum
games.reason: UE5's own shader-precompile systems (5.1-5.4) don't work properly without extra developer work, per Digital Foundry - a general UE5 engine gap this game inherits

games.name: Forspoken
games.reason: Shader-compilation stutter with no precompile step

games.name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
games.reason: Stutters the first time an enemy or effect appears, not on repeats

games.name: WILD HEARTS
games.reason: Shader and traversal stutter; an 850 MB patch did not fix it

games.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
games.reason: Heavy shader compilation at startup and on level loads (Digital Foundry Direct)

games.name: SILENT HILL f
games.reason: Major PSO stutters during play; SCSKiller measured 92 shader stutters on a cold run and 0 after one compile

games.name: SAND LAND
games.reason: Shader-compilation stutter remains during play; SCSKiller measured 38 shader stutters (worst 4.6 s) on a cold run and 1 after one compile

games.name: War Thunder
games.reason: On DirectX 12 the first matches after each update stutter while it compiles its shaders again

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.reason: Its DirectX 12 build compiles shaders while you play; SCSKiller measured 9 shader stutters (worst 1.4 s) on a cold run and 0 after one compile
